company_contact.name: Kepler Tech LLC
company_contact.address: D79 Khalid Bin Waleed Road, Dubai

generic_warranty.terms: All hardware supplied by Kepler Tech carries full manufacturer warranty. We provide genuine manufacturer-backed warranty support; specific duration and terms for individual models (including the Citizen CX-02 warranty) will be confirmed by our technical team.
generic_warranty.statement: All products carry full manufacturer warranty; our team will confirm the specific Citizen CX-02 warranty.

free_shipping.terms: Free shipping on orders over 400 AED across the UAE. For smaller deliveries, older 2023 terms state flat rate AED 10; our team will confirm.

uae.notes: 1–3 day delivery across Dubai and all Emirates. Free shipping on orders over 400 AED. (FAQ states 1–2 days; older 2023 terms state flat rate AED 10; our team will confirm).

saudi_arabia.notes: 5–8 day delivery to Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam & beyond. VAT Inclusive Pricing.

kuwait.notes: 4–6 day delivery across Kuwait City & all governorates. VAT Inclusive Pricing.

qatar.notes: 4–6 day delivery to Doha & all municipalities. VAT Inclusive Pricing.

bahrain.notes: 4–6 day delivery to Manama & all governorates. VAT Inclusive Pricing.

oman.notes: 4–7 day delivery to Muscat, Sohar, Salalah & beyond. VAT Inclusive Pricing.

africa.notes: Pan-Africa shipping to Nigeria, South Africa, Kenya, Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda and more via international air/ocean freight.

order_processing.terms: All orders are processed within 24 hours (1 to 2 business days) after receiving order confirmation.

bulk_discounts.terms: Volume discounts exist for bulk orders, studio bundles, and reseller consignments. Specific discount figures and tailored tier quotations are handled directly by our corporate sales team.

vat_gcc.terms: Pricing for non-UAE GCC countries (Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman) is VAT-inclusive per our official Countries We Serve policy. UAE VAT treatment is subject to customer quotation confirmation.

payment_methods.terms: Payment methods accepted are Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard in AED), Debit Card, and PayPal. You must pay for the goods at the time of placing your order. Goods will not be dispatched until payment is received in full.

cancellation_policy.terms: Customers can cancel their order only within 24 hours of placing the order.

return_policy.terms: We will accept returns of goods that are defective or do not meet the description on our website. Returned goods should be in their original packaging. Return will only be accepted if the delivery packaging has not been opened. You must notify us of any defective or non-conforming goods within 2 days of receipt. Only after you get the approval for return from our side, you may ship your products back to us using a registered courier service. Returns and refunds will only be processed after proper inspection of the returned goods. We reserve the right to refuse any returned shipments if the product has been used or tampered with. Refunds will be done only through the Original Mode of Payment. Please allow for up to 45 days for the refund transfer to be completed.

delivery_charges.terms: Free shipping on orders over 400 AED in the UAE (2026 policy; older 2023 terms state flat rate AED 10; our team will confirm). Delivery fees outside UAE are calculated at checkout based on destination country.

transit_time.terms: UAE domestic deliveries are fulfilled within 1 to 3 business days (FAQ states 1 to 2 days; our team will confirm); international GCC shipments typically take 4 to 8 days; Pan-Africa shipments take 6 to 8 days.

pickup.terms: You can skip the shipping fees with free local pickup at store. After placing your order and selecting local pickup at checkout, your order will be prepared and ready for pick up within 1 to 2 business days.
pickup.location: D79 Khalid Bin Waleed Road, Dubai

tracking.terms: To track your order, visit https://www.keplertechllc.com/track-your-order/ and enter your tracking number. Alternatively, you can reach us directly via phone at +971 521 21 4898 for live updates on your shipment.

delivery_outside_gcc.terms: Kepler Tech delivers across all GCC countries and ships to destinations across Africa. For worldwide destinations outside GCC and Africa, our team will confirm shipping options.

import_duty_vat_outside_uae.terms: Prices for non-UAE GCC destinations include VAT per Countries We Serve policy. For customs duties and import clearance in Africa or international destinations, our freight team assists with documentation.

price_changes.terms: The prices of goods on our website are subject to change without notice. We use our best efforts to ensure that the information on the Site and the price of our products are displayed accurately. However, some system or typographical errors may occur. We reserve the right to correct any and all errors on our website, including pricing errors.
